### When It Feels Like God Is Punishing You
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/when-it-feels-like-god-is-punishing-you
Passage: Hebrews 12:5-6
Points:
- Believers experiencing painful hardships often wonder if God is angrily punishing them.
- Christ bore the full penalty for our sins on the cross, removing all condemnation.
- Painful providences are fatherly discipline meant to train us, not penalize us.
- God's correction demonstrates His deep love and confirms that we are His true children.
- Difficult trials are designed to produce holiness and lasting joy in our lives.

### The Fruit of Discipline
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/fruit-discipline
Passage: Hebrews 12:11
Points:
- Human nature dislikes discipline and often misinterprets hardship as God's absence or rejection.
- Suffering in the Christian life demonstrates that we are legitimate children whom God loves.
- The author of Hebrews acknowledges the genuine pain of discipline while urging believers to persevere.
- Just as earthly parenting yields mature adults, heavenly discipline shapes us into Christlikeness.
- Keeping our eyes on the promised harvest of peace and righteousness helps us endure present pain.
